caption:
Sun conjunct Mercury tomorrow, Nov 4, at 12°10' Scorpio (14:30 UTC): the heart of this Mercury retrograde. ☿

Mercury passes 22' south of the Sun, so it is combust (asta in Jyotish), not cazimi, which needs 17' or less. The Babylonians knew Mercury as Nabu, scribe of the gods; Vedic astrology calls it Budha, son of the Moon.
